race.description: Ladbrokes Tote Win +10% In October Mdn Plate (Set Weights)
race.comment: FLEETING BOOM (11) fought on gamely to hold onto fourth place despite having had enough late at Eagle Farm when making her debut. She will naturally improve with the run, and this time, she will have top hoop Ben Thompson replacing an apprentice. Hard to beat. RECONCILIATE (6) was a flop as the favourite fresh up at Ipswich, and then improved quickly to finish third at Eagle Farm last start. She is peaking at the right time, and should go close. THE AVIATOR (1) made progress last season, and has gone the right way over his spell. He bolted in here at the trials last month, and is ready to rumble fresh. DUCHESS DIFFICULT (3) hit the line strongly fresh up over 1000m, and she can run into the money here. Keep her safe.
